extensions.title: 04 · Instrumental variables
extensions.note: Residential burglary instrumented with business/community burglary. A strong first stage does not establish instrument validity. No causal conclusion is justified by the sign alone.

extensions.title: 05 · Price quantiles
extensions.note: All-crime estimates range from negative at the 5th conditional price percentile to positive at the 95th in the current export. This pilot uses 6,000 observations and 39 successful bootstrap draws per estimate. Conditional quantiles are not fixed groups of homes.

extensions.title: 06 · Neighbourhood effects
extensions.note: The reported beta is own-area crime, even when neighbour controls are added. k is the number of neighbours. These are area-year regressions with LSOA and year effects, not transaction-level M1–M7 estimates.

extensions.title: 06 · Spatial clustering
extensions.note: Positive Moran’s I indicates similar values in nearby areas. Residual clustering can remain after regression controls; this diagnostic is not a causal effect.
